Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads-up and sorry to hear about the last-quarter surprise. We can help. High-level proposal (immediate provisional option):

1) Provisional burst window: 2x current quota for 72 hours, auto-rolloff at the end of the window.
2) Overrun mitigation: For overrun occurring during this window, we’ll apply a 50% credit on the incremental overrun charges up to 150% of your monthly commit. Anything beyond that will revert to standard overrun rates.
3) Conditions: We need a PO or signed amendment within 5 business days of the window start to make the credit permanent on the next invoice. If PO isn’t in place, the provisional credit will be applied as a one-time adjustment and reconciled on the subsequent invoice.

Action items: Can you send a PO or confirm billing contact for the PO? I’ve CC’d Jordan from Contracts so he can confirm any legal/PO wording we need. If you want, I can open a short-term support ticket to expedite the quota change.
